answer: PR #12 modifies four JSON files: infra/kyverno/oya-vcs-admission/application.json (Argo Application, schema_version field), evidence/gitops-vcs/oya-vcs-admission-cutover-2026-05-15.json, evidence/gitops-vcs/provider-execution-proof-2026-05-15.json, evidence/multispectrum/oya-vcs-provider-execution-proof-1778845600.json.
